task.title: Installing Audacity
task.shortdesc: Download Audacity from the official website, or install it with your package manager, and launch it once to finish setup.

prereq.p: You need about 250 MB of free disk space and an account that can install software.

context.p: Audacity is available for Windows, macOS and Linux. The steps differ by operating system only at the install step.

info.p: Select the installer for your operating system.

chrow.chdesc: Double-click the downloaded .exe file and follow the setup wizard. Accept the default location, C:\Program Files\Audacity, unless you have a reason to change it.
Open the downloaded .dmg file and drag Audacity to your Applications folder.
Install from your distribution's package manager, for example sudo apt install audacity on Ubuntu or Debian, sudo dnf install audacity on Fedora.

substep.cmd: If Audacity asks to scan for audio plugins, click OK.

info.p: This happens once, on first launch.

substep.cmd: Choose HelpCheck for Updates to confirm you have the latest version.

stepresult.p: The main window opens with an empty project.

result.p: Audacity is installed and ready to use.

postreq.p: Connect a microphone, then continue with .
